- [USER] User inquired about the best way to store sourdough starter.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided tips for sourdough starter storage:
  - Short-term storage: Room temperature in a clean glass or ceramic container, covered, and fed regularly.
  - Long-term storage: Refrigerate in an airtight container, feed before refrigerating, check every 7-10 days.
  - Freezing: Prepare starter, transfer to an airtight container, label and date, thaw and revive when ready to use.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested to always use clean and sanitized containers and utensils, keep starter away from direct sunlight and strong-smelling foods, and create a backup starter.
- [USER] User is deciding between cinnamon swirl buns and lemon lavender pound cake and asked for tips on achieving the perfect swirl in the buns and balancing the lavender flavor in the cake.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided tips for cinnamon swirl buns:
  - Use the right dough consistency and temperature.
  - Don’t overmix the dough.
  - Use a gentle touch when rolling out the dough.
  - Chill the dough for easier rolling.
  - Use the right amount of filling.
  - Roll and fold gently.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided tips for lemon lavender pound cake:
  - Use high-quality culinary-grade lavender.
  - Start with a small amount of lavender and adjust to taste.
  - Consider using lavender extract for a more subtle flavor.
  - Balance with lemon flavor.
  - Don’t overmix the batter.
